name: Never Speechless (Racial)
body:
No matter the form you take, you can speak as normal.

Prerequisite: Hengeyokai

Benefit: When you use your racial shapechanger ability to adopt a form normally incapable of speech, you can still speak normally. You may also use any class ability requiring speech when in such a form.
